title: Portugal External Growth 1960-1973
description:
Reproducible data repository for studying the relative importance of colonial and European economic linkages in Portuguese growth between 1960 and 1973.

The repository contains data engineering and analytical code only. It intentionally contains no paper, argument, narrative conclusion, or publication draft. The pipeline uses three data layers (immutable raw snapshots, normalised interim tables, and stable processed analysis tables), writes portable metadata sidecars with SHA-256 checksums and input artefact hashes, and applies time-aware partner-group classifications so that historical trade is not classified using current EU membership. Current source integrations include the World Bank Indicators API, UN Comtrade, and BPstat; the pipeline supports future integration of sources including CEPII TRADHIST and transcribed INE, OECD, and EFTA historical documents.
